Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
Monst...@gmail.com wrote:
> I was just wondering what was the reason for WW to print these magazine

> only promos...

Well, the Angelo in Game Trade does seem to be working from a
promotional point of view. To get my Angelos, I had to go into several
game stores and ask for a copy of Game Trade magazine or for the Angelo
out of their store copy. So it's raising retailer awareness that the
game exists and that there's a market for it. It also makes them
appreciate Game Trade, which has gotten people into their stores. And
so Game Trade comes to appreciate VtES more, since it's boosting
retailers' opinion of Game Trade, which means they might devote more
real estate to VtES, which in turn raises retailer and consumer
awareness.

A pretty successful marketing move, I'd guess, especially if the sole
cost is giving Game Trade the stock and a temporary exclusive on the
card.
